frozen_M2.negative_concentration_rule: clip to zero after each step
frozen_M2.obstacle_rule: set non-free coarse cells to zero after each step

source_carrier_contract.placements: all free native cells inside each carrier rectangle

evaluation.target: mean of per-member max-normalized nonzero GADEN peak fields
evaluation.zero_target_member_rule: exclude an all-zero member because normalized spatial shape is undefined; record every exclusion and require at least one nonzero member per carrier
evaluation.M2_prediction: max-over-time advection-diffusion field, then shape normalization
evaluation.baseline: current G2 Gaussian plume max over the same wind states

pass_gate_each_held_out_house: M2 median correlation strictly exceeds plume median correlation
M2 median normalized MSE is strictly below plume median normalized MSE
overall_pass: all four criteria pass in both H02 and H03
failure_action: M2_L0_CROSSHOUSE_NO_GO; do not tune D or source placement after outcomes
scope: predictive field/generalization evidence only; downstream closed-loop utility remains separate
